propositions: Commit 40b8ac8295 eager-loads runtime.py which has an unconditional module-scope import of pydantic.SecretStr, but the reconcile-bridge runs pip install . without the [agents] extra, causing ModuleNotFoundError on every scheduled pass
The reconciler engine and bridge are documented as stdlib-only in pyproject.toml and docs/config.md, and pydantic is declared only in the optional agents extra, violating the stated contract

Clean no-extras local installs reproduce the exact ModuleNotFoundError at runtime.py:39, and adding only pydantic resolves it; historical commits 0f7461d243 and 557f8c16e35 succeed while 40b8ac8295 fails under the same test conditions

The fix replaces pydantic.SecretStr with a stdlib frozen string field with repr/compare=False, preserving credential masking and reveal() behavior at authentication boundaries without adding new dependencies

A subprocess-based oracle test loads the real packaged reconciler runtime with pydantic import-blocked, proving it is RED before repair and GREEN after, and returns to RED when the exact module-scope pydantic import is reintroduced
